name: Button
description: Triggers an action, submits a form, or navigates to another location.

attributes.name: aria-describedby
attributes.description: Identifies the element that describes the button.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Provides an accessible name when visible text is unavailable.

attributes.name: aria-labelledby
attributes.description: Identifies the element that labels the button.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Provides advisory information for the button.

attributes.name: autofocus
attributes.description: Focuses the button when the page loads.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents activation and form submission.

attributes.name: download
attributes.description: Downloads the linked resource, optionally using this value as the filename.

attributes.name: form
attributes.description: Associates the button with a form by element identifier.

attributes.name: formaction
attributes.description: Overrides the associated form action for this submit button.

attributes.name: formenctype
attributes.description: Overrides the associated form encoding type for this submit button.

attributes.name: formmethod
attributes.description: Overrides the associated form method for this submit button.

attributes.name: formnovalidate
attributes.description: Skips validation when this button submits its associated form.

attributes.name: formtarget
attributes.description: Overrides where the associated form response is displayed.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Renders the control as a link to this location.

attributes.name: icon-only
attributes.description: Uses the default slot as the entire button content. An accessible label is required.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Provides fallback text when the default slot is empty.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Sets the form field name submitted with the button value.

attributes.name: rel
attributes.description: Sets the relationship between the current page and a linked resource.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Controls the button dimensions and text size.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Controls where a linked resource is opened.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Controls native button behavior when href is absent.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Sets the form value submitted with the button name.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Controls the visual emphasis and semantic intent.

readonlyProperties.name: control
readonlyProperties.description: The native link or button rendered inside the component.

readonlyProperties.name: form
readonlyProperties.description: The form associated with the button, if one exists.

slots.description: The visible label, or the complete content when icon-only is present.

slots.name: icon-left
slots.description: An icon displayed before the label.

slots.name: icon-right
slots.description: An icon displayed after the label.

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: The native link or button control.

notes: The component emits the standard browser click event.
It renders a native link when href is present and the component is enabled. Otherwise, it renders a native button and supports form submission and reset.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: Choose a semantic variant through the variant attribute.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Compare the large, medium, and small button sizes.
examples.markup:
<noora-button type="button" size="large">Large</noora-button>
<noora-button type="button" size="medium">Medium</noora-button>
<noora-button type="button" size="small">Small</noora-button>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Compare the disabled state across every button variant.
examples.markup:
<noora-button type="button" variant="primary" disabled>Disabled</noora-button>
<noora-button type="button" variant="secondary" disabled>Disabled</noora-button>
<noora-button type="button" variant="destructive" disabled>Disabled</noora-button>

examples.title: Icons
examples.description: Place a chevron on the left, right, or both sides of the label, or render an icon-only button.
examples.markup:
<noora-button type="button">
  <noora-icon slot="icon-left" name="chevron_left"></noora-icon>
  Icon
</noora-button>

<noora-button type="button">
  Icon
  <noora-icon slot="icon-right" name="chevron_right"></noora-icon>
</noora-button>

<noora-button type="button">
  <noora-icon slot="icon-left" name="chevron_left"></noora-icon>
  Icon
  <noora-icon slot="icon-right" name="chevron_right"></noora-icon>
</noora-button>

<noora-button type="button" icon-only aria-label="Previous">
  <noora-icon name="chevron_left"></noora-icon>
</noora-button>
